While your main focus will be at the Front Office, you will also gain valuable exposure within our Food & Beverage outlets, allowing you to develop a well-rounded understanding of hotel operations.

The internship starts in February 2027 and offers a full-time learning experience aligned with your study requirements

Responsibilities

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and guests, contributing to a positive team environment and consistent service delivery

• Support the guest journey, including check-ins, check-outs, and handling guest requests across phone, written, and face-to-face communication

• Assist with reservations, payments, and front office administrative tasks

• Gain hands-on experience within Food & Beverage operations, supporting service where needed

• Maintain a professional and welcoming environment in both Front Office and F&B areas in line with brand standards

• Collaborate with departments such as housekeeping and food and beverage to ensure smooth daily operations
Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a hospitality or related study programme

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Proactive attitude with willingness to learn and develop across departments

• Guest-focused mindset with a positive and professional approach

• Enjoys working in a team and adapting to different operational environments
